question: The 6th-advance CONDITIONAL GO gate: how many of our 25 Biolog carbon sources are covered by PRECISE-NP881's carbon panel?

sources.np881_paper: PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2531884123 (systems-level atlas of carbon-response transcriptional states in E. coli)
sources.np881_metadata_route: ENA portal filereport read_run experiment_title (PNAS page is HTTP 403 bot-block; SRA metadata is the authoritative per-sample carbon annotation)

np881_design_decomposition.note: experiment_title encodes the arm; this was NOT documented in the abstract and is load-bearing
np881_design_decomposition.critical_caveat: Only the C_ arm is physiologically comparable to our panel. The 228 Supp_ runs are glucose-grown with a 10mM supplement -- catabolite repression active, glucose is the carbon source. Using them as if they were sole-carbon conditions would silently confound the bridge.

partial_racemic.note: racemic; supplies L-malate but is not an identical condition -- treat as partial

load_bearing_caveats: SUCCINATE IS MISSING from the carbon panel -- and succinate is the substrate of the SHIPPED 4-media cell and of both fba_strain_design_succ artifacts. The bridge cannot be tested on the shipped cell's own substrate.

The 22/25 union figure mixes NP881's new profiles with 535 public PRECISE-1K profiles (different batches/submissions). The batch-confound risk is real; 16/25 single-provenance is the defensible panel and 22/25 is the optimistic ceiling.
Substrate name matching is normalized (salt forms, hydrates, D-/L- prefixes) -- reviewed by hand, but a chemistry check on the 16 before building E-Flux is cheap insurance.

The Machado & Herrgard 2014 prior (plain FBA + parsimony as good or better than expression-constrained FBA) is UNDISTURBED by this result. It bears on flux, not essentiality, so it stays an indirect prior -- not falsified, not confirmed.
what_this_changes: The 6th advance recorded the bridge as CONDITIONAL GO gated on this count. The count clears: 16 single-provenance matched conditions is a workable panel (our whole conditional-essentiality result rests on 25). The remaining risk is the Machado prior, which is indirect. The blocker is now fully a CODE wall (~1 day of E-Flux work), not a data wall.
next_step_if_pursued: E-Flux over the 16 matched conditions; compare per-cell against the 0.7368 baseline. Pre-register the bar BEFORE looking (the FBA epoch has already produced two self-inflicted verdict reversals from post-hoc filters).
